title: Mixing: Venus And Mars (Reprise) by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

A mixing session for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars took place on 24 March 1975.

The album’s seventh song, ‘Venus And Mars (Reprise)’, was mixed into stereo on this day.

Following the session, Paul and Linda McCartney hosted a launch party for the album aboard the Queen Mary ship at Long Beach.
